steps.name: environment - persist NODE_ENV and ensure npm global bin on PATH (deterministic)
steps.description: Validate node/npm availability (require node >=16) and persist NODE_ENV and npm global bin into /etc/profile.d/npcienv.sh so shells receive NODE_ENV=development and npm global bin is on PATH at runtime. Ensure the workspace directory exists. Atomic write via mktemp and sudo install.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126433/NPCI"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/npcienv.sh
command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'node missing: ensure nodejs >=16 is installed in the container' >&2; exit 2; }
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'npm missing: ensure npm is available' >&2; exit 3; }
NODE_V_RAW=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
NODE_V=${NODE_V_RAW#v}
NODE_MAJOR=${NODE_V%%.*}
if ! printf '%s' "$NODE_MAJOR" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$' || [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "node version >=16 required, found ${NODE_V_RAW:-unknown}. Remediation: update node in the container or use an image with node>=16." >&2
  exit 4
fi
TMP=$(mktemp -p /tmp npcienv.XXXXXX)
cat > "$TMP" <<'EOF'
# NPCI development environment exports
export NODE_ENV=development
# compute npm global bin at shell runtime and add to PATH if present
NG_BIN="$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)"
[ -n "$NG_BIN" ] && export PATH="$NG_BIN:$PATH"
EOF
sudo install -m 644 "$TMP" "$PROFILE" || { rm -f "$TMP"; echo 'failed to write profile' >&2; exit 5; }
rm -f "$TMP"
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE"

steps.name: scaffolding - initialize minimal CRA project in workspace (JS by default, no network, safe-overwrite or alternate target)
steps.description: Initialize a minimal create-react-app project in WORKSPACE. Behavior: if package.json exists, validate it and ensure start/build scripts and a .env (HOST/PORT) without clobbering an existing .env. If no package.json and the workspace is empty or contains only a safe whitelist, create the app using the globally installed create-react-app (no network). If workspace contains other files, the script will abort unless ALLOW_SCAFFOLD_OVERWRITE=true is set (non-interactive) — in that override mode existing non-whitelisted files are moved to a timestamped backup under WORKSPACE/.npcibak/<ts>/ before scaffolding. Alternatively, SCAFFOLD_TARGET_DIR (absolute path) may be set to initialize into a different directory. This provides deterministic automation while giving explicit, non-interactive options to proceed safely.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126433/NPCI"
TARGET_DIR="${SCAFFOLD_TARGET_DIR:-}"
[ -n "$TARGET_DIR" ] && WORK_DIR="$TARGET_DIR" || WORK_DIR="$WORKSPACE"
mkdir -p "$WORK_DIR"
cd "$WORK_DIR"
# If package.json exists, validate and ensure scripts and .env (do not overwrite .env)
if [ -f package.json ]; then
  node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'))" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'existing package.json invalid' >&2; exit 6; }
  node -e "let fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" || { echo 'failed to ensure package.json scripts' >&2; exit 9; }
  if [ ! -f .env ]; then cat > .env <<'EOF'
HOST=0.0.0.0
PORT=3000
EOF
  fi
  exit 0
fi
# Workspace empty/safe check
SAFE_OK=true
shopt -s dotglob nullglob
for f in *; do
  case "$f" in
    .|..) continue;;
    .git|.gitignore|README.md|README|LICENSE|LICENSE.md|.env.example) continue;;
    '') continue;;
    *) SAFE_OK=false; break;;
  esac
done
if [ "$SAFE_OK" != true ]; then
  if [ "${ALLOW_SCAFFOLD_OVERWRITE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
    TS=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
    BAKDIR="$WORK_DIR/.npcibak/$TS"
    mkdir -p "$BAKDIR"
    # move non-whitelisted files to backup
    for f in *; do
      case "$f" in
        .|..) continue;;
        .git|.gitignore|README.md|README|LICENSE|LICENSE.md|.env.example) continue;;
        '') continue;;
        *) mv -T "$f" "$BAKDIR/" 2>/dev/null || mv "$f" "$BAKDIR/" 2>/dev/null || true;;
      esac
    done
  else
    echo 'workspace non-empty and not in safe state; aborting scaffold. To force in-place scaffold set ALLOW_SCAFFOLD_OVERWRITE=true (script will backup non-whitelisted files), or set SCAFFOLD_TARGET_DIR to an alternate clean path.' >&2
    exit 7
  fi
fi
# require global create-react-app to avoid network fetch during automation
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  create-react-app . --use-npm --silent || { echo 'create-react-app failed' >&2; exit 8; }
else
  echo 'create-react-app is not installed globally in the image; automated scaffold will not perform network fetch. Install create-react-app globally or run scaffold manually with network access.' >&2
  exit 10
fi
# ensure package.json scripts and only create .env if absent
node -e "let fs=require('fs'),p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" || { echo 'failed to ensure package.json scripts' >&2; exit 9; }
if [ ! -f .env ]; then cat > .env <<'EOF'
HOST=0.0.0.0
PORT=3000
EOF
fi

steps.name: dependencies - install project dependencies (lockfile-aware, deterministic)
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively in WORKSPACE. Require package.json to exist. Prefer yarn when yarn.lock present; else prefer npm ci when package-lock.json present; otherwise npm install. Optionally install serve as a devDependency if INSTALL_SERVE=true. Skip install if node_modules exists and react-scripts resolves locally.

install
output_scripts.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# dependencies - install project dependencies (lockfile-aware, deterministic)
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126433/NPCI"
# validate workspace
[ -d "$WORKSPACE" ] || { echo "workspace missing: $WORKSPACE" >&2; exit 20; }
cd "$WORKSPACE"
# check node + npm
NODE_BIN=$(command -v node || true)
NPM_BIN=$(command -v npm || true)
if [ -z "$NODE_BIN" ] || [ -z "$NPM_BIN" ]; then
  echo "node or npm not available on PATH" >&2
  exit 21
fi
NODE_VER=$($NODE_BIN -v | sed 's/^v//')
# require node >=16
NODE_MAJOR=$(echo "$NODE_VER" | cut -d. -f1)
if [ "${NODE_MAJOR:-0}" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "node >=16 required, found $NODE_VER" >&2
  exit 22
fi
# ensure package.json exists
[ -f package.json ] || { echo 'package.json missing: run scaffold first' >&2; exit 11; }
# skip if node_modules exists and react-scripts resolves locally
if [ -d node_modules ]; then
  if node -e "try{require.resolve('react-scripts');process.exit(0)}catch(e){process.exit(2)}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
  fi
fi
# choose package manager and perform deterministic install
if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  # prefer yarn with frozen lockfile
  yarn install --frozen-lockfile --silent || { echo 'yarn install failed' >&2; exit 12; }
elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'npm ci failed' >&2; exit 13; }
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --silent || { echo 'npm install failed' >&2; exit 14; }
fi
# optionally install serve as devDependency
if [ "${INSTALL_SERVE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
  # use npm to add devDependency deterministically; if yarn present and yarn.lock exists, use yarn add --dev --silent --exact
  if [ -f yarn.lock ] && command -v yarn >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    yarn add --dev serve --silent || { echo 'yarn add serve devDependency failed' >&2; exit 15; }
  else
    npm i --no-audit --no-fund --save-dev serve --silent || { echo 'install serve devDependency failed' >&2; exit 15; }
  fi
fi
# verify react-scripts available locally
node -e "try{require.resolve('react-scripts');process.exit(0)}catch(e){process.exit(2)}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'react-scripts not resolvable after install' >&2; exit 16; }

steps.name: start - create workspace helper to run CRA dev server (executable)
steps.description: Create an executable helper script in the workspace (start.sh) that runs the CRA dev server binding to HOST (default 0.0.0.0) and honoring PORT env. This helper uses the local npm start to ensure deterministic behavior.

steps.name: validation - build, serve static assets, health-check and stop
steps.description: Build the CRA app (npm run build), serve the build folder and perform HTTP health-checks against the configured HOST/PORT. Prefer local node_modules/.bin/serve (if devDependency installed via INSTALL_SERVE=true); otherwise use python3 -m http.server. Wait with exponential backoff for readiness, probe using HOST and PORT, provide logs on failure, and ensure clean stop via trap.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/ekyc-application-125058-126433/NPCI"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
HOST=${HOST:-127.0.0.1}
PORT=${PORT:-3000}
BUILD_LOG=/tmp/npcibuild.log
SERVE_LOG=/tmp/npciserve.log
OUT=/tmp/npcival.out
PIDFILE=/tmp/npciserve.pid
# build
npm run build >"$BUILD_LOG" 2>&1 || (echo 'build failed, see' "$BUILD_LOG" >&2; sed -n '1,200p' "$BUILD_LOG" || true; exit 14)
# choose server: prefer local node_modules/.bin/serve if present
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then
  node_modules/.bin/serve -s build -l "$PORT" >"$SERVE_LOG" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
elif [ "${INSTALL_SERVE:-false}" = "true" ] && command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  serve -s build -l "$PORT" >"$SERVE_LOG" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
else
  (cd build && python3 -m http.server "$PORT") >"$SERVE_LOG" 2>&1 &
  PID=$!
fi
echo "$PID" > "$PIDFILE"
trap 'kill ${PID:-0} 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$PIDFILE"' EXIT
# wait with backoff up to ~45s
attempt=0
sleep_time=0.5
max_attempts=30
while [ $attempt -lt $max_attempts ]; do
  sleep "$sleep_time"
  HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o "$OUT" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$HOST:$PORT/" || echo 000)
  if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "000" ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 400 ]; then break; fi
  attempt=$((attempt+1))
  sleep_time=$((sleep_time*2))
  [ $sleep_time -gt 5 ] && sleep_time=5
done
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o "$OUT" -w '%{http_code}' "http://$HOST:$PORT/" || echo 000)
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "000" ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 400 ]; then
  echo "validation failed status=$HTTP_CODE; logs: $SERVE_LOG and $BUILD_LOG" >&2
  sed -n '1,200p' "$SERVE_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
  sed -n '1,200p' "$BUILD_LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
  exit 15
else
  echo "validation: ok status=$HTTP_CODE"
  head -c 256 "$OUT" || true
fi
kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$PIDFILE"
trap - EXIT
